item.title: Economics of LEGO Sets with Data Science
item.description: I collect LEGO and write Python, so I merged Rebrickable exports with a BrickEconomy scraper to see how sets and themes evolved, and whether a simple model could follow the resale price of a classic set like 001-1. The notebooks and scraper live in AlgoETS/LegosTracker[1].
